lucee.notes:
Since Lucee 6, this function iterates over each character in the string.

For list-based iteration with delimiters, use [[function-listeach]] instead.

[LDEV-3747](https://luceeserver.atlassian.net/browse/LDEV-3747)

name: StringEach
description: Iterates over a string and runs the closure function for each element in the string.

params.name: closure
params.description: Closure or a function reference that will be called for each of the iteration.
